objects.name: Analytic 2085
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a session (Telnet, SSH, proprietary, etc.) opened to an embedded field device from a source not in the approved administrative CIDR, immediately followed by configuration-mode entry or high-risk commands (firmware operations, config write/erase, reload) or identifies sequences of Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol commands arriving at field devices that follow a scripted, deterministic pattern -- identical inter-command timing, systematic address iteration -- rather than the variable, operator-driven timing of legitimate engineering sessions. Operational Technology (OT) operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
